GOOD QUESTIONS. USEFUL ANSWERS.

A FEW THINGS
BEHIND THE LABEL.

How do I see a brand’s equipment?

Choose a name in the directory. The product page opens with that brand selected; you can then narrow the results by sport.

Does a brand listing mean the shop is an official partner?

No. Brand names identify the products pictured in the catalogue and do not imply an endorsement or affiliation.

Are all shown items currently available?

The catalogue is a frontend showcase. Confirm model specifications, current stock and final pricing directly with the store.

Can I compare across brands?

Yes. Use the sport filters and saved favourites to build a shortlist around your playing needs rather than a name alone.
